main_idea: PivotRL raised Qwen3.5-9B pass@5 on τ³-Banking from 11.3% to 17.5%.
ideas: PivotRL improved task success from 11.3% to 17.5%.
The method used 50 solved trajectories and profiled 193 pivot states.
summary: Branding, slogan text, a repeated explanation, decorative annotations, and secondary sample-count cards compete with the result chart.

regions.label: red
regions.name: brand header
regions.reason: Logo and organizational descriptor do not help read the result.

regions.label: red
regions.name: topic kicker
regions.reason: The model and benchmark are already named in the chart headline.

regions.label: orange
regions.name: two-line headline
regions.reason: A broad two-line slogan is longer than a concise result-focused title.

regions.label: red
regions.name: decorative motif
regions.reason: Faint abstract bars add no information.

regions.label: red

regions.reason: It restates the improvement and adds method details already summarized elsewhere.

regions.label: blue
regions.name: pass rate chart
regions.reason: Bars, category labels, values, and scale show the central before-and-after result.

regions.label: red
regions.name: chart section label
regions.reason: The axis and percentages already establish what the chart measures.

regions.label: red
regions.name: success annotation
regions.reason: Side arrow and vertical label duplicate the chart's measure.

regions.label: red

regions.reason: Sample counts add a secondary methodology point beside the main result.
